Plug in the values of a, b, and c. If the discriminant (b² - 4ac) is positive, you get two real solutions; if zero, one; if negative, two complex solutions. To find the stationary points, take the first derivative of f(x), which gives you f'(x). Set f'(x) equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values are the points where the slope of the curve is zero.
